howItWorks.title: Browse China. Buy smarter. We deliver.
howItWorks.subtitle: Use the app to shop from 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods and JD — ChinaSuuq handles the buying, inspection, shipping and delivery to your door in Somalia.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Open the app and explore 1688, Taobao, YiwuGo, Alibaba, ChinaGoods and JD — in real time, with English and Somali translation built in.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Tap the + button on any product you like, or paste a product link. ChinaSuuq detects the price, images, and variants automatically.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Pick color, size, model and how many units. Compare air (7-14 days) vs sea (25-40 days) shipping and see the total in your local currency.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Complete payment with ZAAD, eDahab, Premier Wallet, bank transfer, or USDT. We confirm every order on WhatsApp before buying.
howItWorks.step5Desc: Our team purchases from verified Chinese suppliers, inspects each item at our China warehouse, and shares photos before shipping.
howItWorks.step6Desc: Choose pickup from our Hargeisa branch or full door delivery. We handle customs, consolidation, and the last mile to your address.
howItWorks.cta: Download the app and start shopping
